title: Simultaneous Lengthening of Bilateral Femora and Tibiae in Achondroplastic Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether lengthening of both the tibiae and femora in achondroplastic patients is safe and provides reproducible outcome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Achondroplasia, first lengthening period

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous lengthening
